capabilities: Pull shared Feishu wiki trees and single /docx/ documents into the vault as Markdown with images
Check for remote updates fetch-only and pull one wiki or all flagged updates
Sync notes bidirectionally or push-only into Feishu docs, with conflict copies and backups
Convert Feishu highlight blocks to Obsidian callouts and bookmark blocks to links
Manage multiple wikis, sync directions, and re-authorization from a status-bar panel
extras: README is mostly Chinese with the full illustrated setup guide in docs/使用步骤.md. Free and open source (MIT). Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.13.7+) and connects to China Feishu (open.feishu.cn) only, not international Lark. Tables, Bitable, and PDF attachments are not synced yet; single-document mode only supports new /docx/ links. Stores tokens and sync mappings unencrypted in data.json.
intentEvidence: 本仓库是 chenqaq123/ObsidianSync 的二次开发版本。在上游 0.1.2 的基础上做了若干增强；感谢上游作者的工作。
motivation: The author consumes most material in Feishu wikis and wanted it in Obsidian for use with AI; manual copy-paste was slow and stale, and Feishu's native export is PDF only.
problem: Feishu wikis offer no bulk export to Markdown, and the upstream plugin only handled one wiki at a time, missed subtree images, could not fetch shared /docx/ links, and pushed to read-only wikis.
